name: Troll Charm
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Mitsuwa seeks sacred charms stolen from his kin. A traveling party of Darkspear trolls was ambushed and slaughtered by the Thistlefur furbolgs, who took the talismans into their den.

sections.title: An Ambushed Caravan
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost is a remote Horde refuge on Ashenvale's western coast. Woodland paths make travel there dangerous. A party of Darkspear trolls never reached the post after the Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed them. Mitsuwa accepts that his kin have died and will one day meet him in the afterlife. Their sacred charms were stolen from the dead, however, and he cannot abide that insult.

sections.title: Sacred Trinkets
sections.body: Troll charms and talismans mark identity, offer spiritual protection, and bind their bearers to the Loa. Mitsuwa sees a troll without her charm as hollow and worthless, like an orc without battle scars. The Thistlefur furbolgs carried the stolen charms to Thistlefur Hold, deep in the caves beyond Thistlefur Village. They hid the talismans in chests, far from their rightful owners.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Mitsuwa, a Darkspear troll, is at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand along Ashenvale's northwestern coast.

faq.q: Why are the troll charms so important to Mitsuwa?
faq.answer: Troll charms carry deep spiritual and cultural meaning. Mitsuwa sees a troll without her charm as an orc without battle scars, and the furbolgs' possession of these relics desecrates his slain kin.

faq.q: Where are the troll charms located?
faq.answer: The charms are in chests inside Thistlefur Hold, a deep cavern complex at the northern edge of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.
The Thistlefur furbolgs stole the charms. They ambushed and killed Mitsuwa's kin as they traveled toward Zoram'gar Outpost, then carried the charms into their caverns.

faq.q: What happened to the trolls who originally carried the charms?
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs killed the trolls along the trail. Mitsuwa mourns them and believes they will meet again in the afterlife, while he seeks to recover their sacred relics.

faq.q: Is this quest available to the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. Mitsuwa offers this to the Horde at Zoram'gar Outpost.

angles.text: As a troll, recovering the charms is a spiritual duty. These sacred ancestral items must be rescued from the furbolgs.
As a member of the Horde, striking into Thistlefur territory pushes back against woodland threats that ambush Horde supply lines and travelers in Ashenvale.
